deploy.// restartPolicyType: ALWAYS, not ON_FAILURE with a retry cap: this process is the only house cron driver, so a crash loop that used up the retries would stop every cron pass until a manual redeploy.
deploy.// numReplicas: Pinned to 1 because the in-process cronInflight guard does not coordinate across replicas. Scaling to 2 silently doubles every cron tick (and every Vercel function invocation). If horizontal scale is ever needed, move the inflight guard into Redis/Postgres first.
